method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

server_info.name: push-docs
server_info.title: Push Chain Documentation
server_info.description: Read-only MCP server for push.org documentation and the Push Chain agent layer. Content is a static snapshot generated at site build time.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search push.org docs
tools.description: Full text search over push.org documentation. Returns ranked results with title, url, section, snippet, and score. Optionally filter by section.

section.description: Restrict results to one docs section, e.g. "build" or "setup"

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 5, max 20

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Get a docs page as markdown
tools.description: Fetches one push.org docs page as clean markdown with frontmatter metadata (title, url, section, lastUpdated). Accepts exactly one of "url" or "path". Only pages inside the indexed docs set can be fetched.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.title: List docs sections
tools.description: Returns the hierarchical map of the push.org docs tree: sections, page titles, and urls. Pass "section" to get a single subtree.

section.description: Return only the subtree for this section

tools.name: get_agent_resource
tools.title: Get a Push Chain agent-layer file
tools.description: Returns the raw JSON of one push.org agent-layer file, snapshotted at build time. Resources: capabilities, errors, contract-addresses, supported-chains, sdk-capabilities, changelog. These mirror https://push.org/agents/.
